About the Company 

 At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.

 A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners.  Now a part of the Daimler family , we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. 

 Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer. 

 Meet the Team: 

You will be working with Torc's map enablement team to review and conduct quality control work on high-definition map datasets used by Torc's autonomous trucks. This role is responsible for auditing HD map geospatial datasets (lane geometry, road boundaries, signage, and other map features derived from LiDAR point clouds and sensor data) to ensure it meets the accuracy and completeness standards required for safe autonomous operation on highways and surface streets. You'll work closely with mapping engineers, mapping vendors, and autonomy teams to catch defects before they reach the vehicle, and to turn recurring issues into process and workflow improvements.

Torc's map enablement team is looking for a quality control engineer to help deliver and scale its mapping operation for Torc's commercial expansion. This individual will collaborate with engineering teams that use mapping datasets to create tailored QC workflows, turning feedback into optimized processes that scale as Torc's operational mapping footprint grows.


 What You'll Do 



 
 Review HD map geospatial data (lane geometry, road boundaries, intersections, signage, lane connectivity) against internal quality specifications and ground-truth sources

 Perform QC on map features derived from LiDAR point clouds, aerial/satellite imagery, and vehicle-collected sensor data

 Identify, document, and triage map defects, escalating safety-critical issues to mapping and autonomy engineering teams

 Define and refine QC metrics, sampling strategies, and audit workflows to measure and improve map accuracy at scale

 Partner with mapping vendors and internal teams to communicate quality standards and drive defect resolution

 Analyze recurring defect patterns and feed findings back into upstream map creation and annotation processes to reduce future errors

 Maintain clear documentation of QC procedures, edge cases, and regional/route-specific map requirements

 Support readiness reviews for new lanes, corridors, or operational design domains (ODDs) prior to launch

 
 What you'll need: 

 
 Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geomatics, Geography, Surveying, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 1–3 years of experience (QC Engineer I) or 3–5 years (QC Engineer II) in geospatial data QC, map production, GIS analysis, or a related quality/annotation role

 Experience working with geospatial data formats (e.g., shapefiles, GeoJSON, KML) and coordinate/projection systems

 Familiarity with GIS tools (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS) and/or LiDAR/point cloud viewers

 Strong attention to detail and ability to identify subtle spatial or geometric inconsistencies in large datasets

 Comfort working with large datasets and defining repeatable, data-driven QC processes

 Clear written communication skills for documenting defects and QC standards for both technical and non-technical audiences

 Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and third-party vendor teams

 
 Additional for QC Engineer II: 

 
 Experience designing or improving QC processes/tooling from the ground up, not just executing existing checklists

 Track record of mentoring junior reviewers or leading vendor/annotator quality calibration

 Experience defining map quality metrics and reporting on trends to engineering stakeholders

 
 Bonus Points: 

 
 HD mapping experience, particularly for autonomous vehicles or trucking

 Familiarity with map representations/standards used in autonomy stacks (e.g., Lanelet2, OpenDRIVE, OpenStreetMap)

 Experience with LiDAR point cloud processing/classification tools (e.g., TerraScan, TerraSolid, LP360)

 Scripting experience (Python or SQL) for automating QC checks or building spatial queries (e.g., PostGIS)

 Experience with highway/interstate corridor mapping specifically (relevant to trucking ODDs)

 Prior experience working with or managing outsourced/vendor annotation teams

 Familiarity with functional safety or quality standards relevant to AV development (e.g., ISO 26262, ASPICE)

 
 
 Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r  
 

 
 Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:   

 
 A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options

 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees   

 401K plan with a 6% employer matchFlexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)Company-wide holiday office closures

 AD+D and Life Insurance  

 
 At Torc, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities. 

 Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply. 

 Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. Dependent on the position offered, sign-on payments, relocation, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. 

 Job ID: 102992
